title: PM-KISAN 17th Installment Disbursed
message: Direct benefit transfer of ₹2,000 released for eligible landholding farmer families with completed e-KYC and Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Coverage Expansion
message: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card now available for all senior citizens aged 70 and above, offering ₹5 lakh health cover regardless of family income.

title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Applications Open
message: Online application window for Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, and Merit-cum-Means scholarships for the academic year 2026-27 is now open.

title: Aadhaar-Bank Account Seeding Mandatory
message: Ensure your bank account is seeded with Aadhaar and NPCI mapped to receive direct benefit transfer (DBT) subsidies without delay.
